1.text: Avuye mu rusengero umwe mu bigishwa be aramubwira ati “Mbega amabuye! Mbega imyubakire! Mbese aho Mwigisha, urirebera?”

2.text: Yesu aramubaza ati “Urareba iyi myubakire minini? Ntihazasigara ibuye rigeretse ku rindi ritajugunywe hasi.”

3.text: Yicaye ku musozi wa Elayono yerekeye urusengero, Petero na Yakobo na Yohana na Andereya bamubaza biherereye bati

4.text: “Tubwire, ibyo bizabaho ryari, n'ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko igihe bizasohoreramo cyegereje ni ikihe?”

5.text: Yesu atangira kubabwira ati “Mwirinde hatagira umuntu ubayobya,

6.text: kuko benshi bazaza biyita izina ryanjye bati ‘Ni jye Kristo’, bakayobya benshi.

7.text: Nuko nimwumva intambara n'impuha z'intambara ntimuzahagarike imitima, kuko ibyo bitazabura kubaho, ariko imperuka izaba itaraza.

8.text: Ishyanga rizatera irindi shyanga, n'ubwami buzatera ubundi bwami. Hamwe na hamwe hazaba ibishyitsi, hazaba n'inzara. Ibyo bizaba ari itangiriro ryo kuramukwa.

9.text: “Ariko mwirinde kuko bazabagambanira mu nkiko, muzakubitirwa mu masinagogi kandi muzahagarara imbere y'abategeka n'abami babampora, ngo mubabere ubuhamya.

10.text: Ubutumwa bwiza bukwiriye kubanza kumara kwamamazwa mu mahanga yose.

11.text: Nibabajyana mu manza ntimuzahagarike imitima y'ibyo muzavuga, ahubwo ibyo muzabwirwa muri icyo gihe muzabe ari byo muvuga, kuko atari mwe muzaba muvuga, ahubwo ari Umwuka Wera.

12.text: Umuvandimwe azagambanira mwene se ngo yicwe, na se w'umwana azamugambanira, abana bazagomera ababyeyi babicishe.

13.text: Kandi muzangwa na bose babahora izina ryanjye, ariko uwihangana akageza imperuka ni we uzakizwa.

14.text: “Ariko nimubona ikizira kirimbura kigeze aho kidakwiriye, (usoma abyitondere), icyo gihe abazaba bari i Yudaya bazahungire ku misozi,

15.text: n'uzaba ari hejuru y'inzu ye kuzamanuka, ngo yinjire mu nzu ye ngo agire icyo akuramo,

16.text: n'uzaba ari mu murima ye kuzasubira imuhira ngo azane umwenda we.

17.text: “Abazaba batwite n'abonsa muri iyo minsi bazabona ishyano!

18.text: Nuko musenge kugira ngo bitazabaho mu mezi y'imbeho,

19.text: kuko muri iyo minsi hazabaho umubabaro mwinshi utigeze kubaho, uhereye mu itangiriro ubwo Imana yaremaga ukageza none, kandi ntuzongera kubaho.

20.text: Iyaba Umwami Imana itagabanyije iyo minsi, ntihajyaga kuzarokoka umuntu n'umwe, ariko ku bw'intore yatoranyije yayigabanyijeho.

21.text: “Icyo gihe umuntu nababwira ati ‘Dore Kristo ari hano’, cyangwa ati ‘Dore ari hariya’ ntimuzabyemere,

22.text: kuko hazaduka abiyita Kristo n'abahanuzi b'ibinyoma bakora ibimenyetso n'ibitangaza, kugira ngo babone uko bayobya n'intore niba bishoboka.

23.text: Ariko mwebwe mwirinde, dore mbibabwiye byose bitaraba.

24.text: “Ariko muri iyo minsi, hanyuma y'uwo mubabaro, izuba rizijima n'ukwezi ntikuzava umwezi wako,

25.text: n'inyenyeri zizagwa ziva mu ijuru, n'imbaraga zo mu ijuru zizanyeganyega.

26.text: Ubwo ni bwo bazabona Umwana w'umuntu aje ku bicu, afite ubushobozi bwinshi n'ubwiza.

27.text: Azatuma abamarayika, ateranye intore ze mu birere bine, uhereye ku mpera y'isi ukageza ku mpera y'ijuru.

28.text: “Nuko rero murebere ku mutini, ni wo cyitegererezo, ishami ryawo iyo ritoshye ibibabi bikamera, mumenya yuko igihe cy'impeshyi kiri bugufi.

29.text: Nuko namwe nimubona ibyo bisohoye, muzamenya yuko ari hafi ndetse ko ageze ku rugi.

30.text: Ndababwira ukuri yuko ab'ubu bwoko batazashiraho, kugeza aho ibyo byose bizasohorera.

31.text: Ijuru n'isi bizashira, ariko amagambo yanjye ntazashira na hato.

32.text: “Ariko uwo munsi cyangwa icyo gihe nta wubizi, naho baba abamarayika bo mu ijuru cyangwa Umwana w'Imana, keretse Data.

33.text: Mujye mwirinda, mube maso musenge, kuko mutazi igihe ibyo bizasohoreramo.

34.text: Ni nk'umuntu wasize urugo rwe ajya mu kindi gihugu, aha abagaragu be ubutware, umuntu wese ahabwa umurimo we, ategeka umukumirizi kuba maso.

35.text: Nuko namwe mube maso kuko mutazi igihe nyir'urugo azaziramo, niba ari nimugoroba cyangwa mu gicuku, cyangwa mu nkoko cyangwa umuseke utambitse,

37.text: Icyo mbabwiye ndakibwira bose nti ‘Mube maso.’ ”
